# tailor-react 0.11.1

Vendored copy of tailor-react (the `Ui.*` components, `useTailorTheme`, `<Ui.Pickers>`), written by
`tailor apply --react` and kept current by `tailor sync`. Do not edit these files. Wire it as a workspace
member (`"workspaces": ["vendor/tailor-react", …]` + `"tailor-react": "workspace:*"`) or a `file:` dependency.
The sources are TypeScript with `.ts`/`.tsx` import extensions: compile them with your app's bundler
(`moduleResolution: "bundler"`, `allowImportingTsExtensions`). Docs: https://github.com/rojosinalma/tailor/tree/v0.11.1/react
